sam li: Quick neighborhood check: final partner readiness call tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need confirmation on three items: partner badge redirect, SI deployment window, and press embargo acknowledgement.
elaine cho: Badge redirect ready, nginx rules in repo, Ill run one last test during your call.
rafi alvarez: SI deployment window confirmed 02:00-06:00 UTC. Engineers on standby. Add rollback flag in runbook.
partners-bot: Action created: send embargo notice to partners list at 2026-03-26T12:00:00Z.
press-team: We sent embargo details last week. Partners must acknowledge by replying to the email; only acknowledged partners can publish.
legal-escalations: Reminder: partners cannot use Redwood logos until co-brand asset pack is signed. Include the clause in the partner packet.
sam li: thanks. Quick operational note: if partner onboarding spikes >150/hr route to dedicated onboarding pool; metric name: partner.onboard.rate.rafi, can you add the alert?
rafi alvarez: will do, paging rule to partner-oncall.
elaine cho: Test badge curl looks good: 200, svg returned. I pushed a small TTL change for caching.
sam li: great. Final ask: who will be the partner-facing signal during press window? press-team or sam?
press-team: well own press-facing comms. Sam you own partner hotline and technical escalations.
sam li: locking this thread. Call tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Ill follow up with the packet link. :rocket:
